name: @sop/extension
description: The sickofpdfs Chrome extension (Manifest V3, built with WXT).

scripts.assets: node scripts/copy-engine-assets.mjs && node scripts/copy-ort-assets.mjs && node scripts/fetch-minilm.mjs && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm assets && node scripts/minilm-prototypes.mjs --check && node scripts/minilm-subjects.mjs --check && wxt build && node scripts/check-no-cdn.mjs .output/chrome-mv3 && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check .output/chrome-mv3
scripts.build:e2e: pnpm assets && node scripts/minilm-prototypes.mjs --check && node scripts/minilm-subjects.mjs --check && wxt build --mode test && node scripts/check-no-cdn.mjs .output/chrome-mv3-test && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check .output/chrome-mv3-test
